summary: E2E tested the Closed Beta Program (backend + frontend). Backend endpoints /api/beta/status, /api/beta/signup and /api/beta/feedback validated via 10-test pytest suite (8 passed, 2 skipped due to intentional 3/hour rate limit). Frontend /beta and /beta/feedback routes render, data-testids are complete, landing banner shows live counter, clicks navigate, dismiss works and persists for session. Full signup wizard (intro -> phone -> OTP -> details -> success) exercised successfully in the happy-path backend run (membership_id DC-BETA-YYYYMM-NNN, expires_at ~30 days, duration_days=30, counter bumps by 1). Resume path (same-phone re-signup without counter increment) was indirectly validated via code review + the non-bumping cap branch, but automated retest was blocked by the 3/hour limiter.

minor.issue: Rate limit is 3/hour per IP on both successful AND 400-rejection responses. This makes iterative end-to-end testing from a single origin (preview/test runner) exhaust the quota quickly. Consider (a) only counting successful attempts or (b) making the cap configurable via env for testing.

issues: Component shows default state '0 of 100 spots taken · 100 left' for a brief moment before the /api/beta/status fetch resolves. Not a bug, but a hydration flash; could be mitigated by lazy-rendering the counter until first response or using suspense-style skeleton.

action_items: OPTIONAL: loosen limiter on /api/beta/signup (or skip counting rejections) so E2E automation can verify flows without exhausting quota in <4 requests.
OPTIONAL: add a skeleton/loading state for the /beta spots-counter during the first fetch so the initial 0/100 flash doesn't leak stale defaults.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~4322 lines — consider splitting the beta module (lines 3185-3399) into /app/backend/routes/beta.py.
validate_phone_number is used in beta_signup but /otp/send uses its own inline check (`len==10 and phone[0] in '6789'`). Consolidate to a single utility to avoid drift.
BETA_MAX_SPOTS is hardcoded. Expose via env (e.g., os.environ.get('BETA_MAX_SPOTS', 100)) to allow non-prod overrides for cap-enforcement tests.
beta_signup welcome email is best-effort inside the request handler — acceptable but consider offloading to a background task for latency (currently synchronous _send_email call).
BetaPage.js initial status state `{spots_left:100,taken:0,is_open:true}` can briefly mislead users when real state is different (e.g., only 3 left). Render counter only after first successful fetch.

success_rate.backend: 100% (8/8 executable tests passed; 2 skipped only due to rate-limiter after quota was exhausted)
success_rate.frontend: ~95% (all testids render, all routes 200, banner + dismiss + click-to-beta + feedback flow all pass; UI signup submit blocked post-quota by 3/hour limiter on the shared test IP)

test_credentials: Sandbox OTP returned in /api/otp/send response body (sandbox_otp field). Test phones randomised (9XXXXXXXXX). No admin login required for beta flows.
seed_data_creation: Created 3 TEST_ beta subscribers in db.subscribers (isBeta=true). Taken counter is at 3/100. Safe to leave or purge via db.subscribers.deleteMany({email: /^TEST_/}).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Rate limit on /api/beta/signup is 3/hour/IP and counts BOTH 2xx and 4xx responses. Restart backend (sudo supervisorctl restart backend) to reset the in-memory slowapi store before re-running test_beta_program.py. The skipped tests (resume-same-phone and paid-user-blocked) have been validated by logical code review: resume path flows through `if not (existing and existing.get('isBeta'))` before cap check so same-phone re-signup bypasses the cap and does not re-increment the beta-count (the $set is idempotent on isBeta=True). The paid-block branch triggers when `existing.get('isPaid')` is truthy while isBeta is not — requires a paid but non-beta subscriber to reproduce.
rca_of_issues: N/A — no functional bugs found. UI signup timeout observed in round-2 browser test was due to the upstream /api/beta/signup rate-limit 429 (confirmed in /var/log/supervisor/backend.out.log: 'ratelimit 3 per 1 hour exceeded at endpoint: /api/beta/signup'). This is expected throttling behaviour, not a bug.
